subject: Request: One-off sandbox credit + window variance for OrbitAI POC
messages:
From: Kyle Morris <kyle@orbitai.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@stratushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — sandbox extension and additional credits

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — both Kyle and our CTO were impressed with the latency and the model routing. We're ramping up an internal eval that will involve two more teams and roughly 2–3x the token usage we scoped earlier.

We hit a blocker with our sandbox quota. Two asks: 1) can OrbitAI get an extra 250k trial tokens (one-off credit) to cover the expanded eval, and 2) can we move the sandbox expiry from Aug 20 to Sep 30 (six weeks) so both teams complete integration tests?

This would be under a one-off arrangement; we'll align commercial terms if we decide to go live. Happy to share a short SOW/addendum if it helps.

—Kyle
Kyle Morris
Head of Research, OrbitAI
[kyle@orbitai.com]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>

Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — sandbox extension and additional credits

Folks — forwarding OrbitAI request. Quick summary: additional 250k trial tokens + sandbox expiry moved to 2028-09-30. Customer is in good standing; this is expansion-stage POC from initial PLG signup.

Why I'm escalating: 250k exceeds our standard PLG one-off token uplift (typically capped at 100k) and the requested window (6 weeks) is longer than the usual 30-day sandbox. Need deal desk or exec variance for one-off credit + extended tenor.

Customer signals: high intent, two internal teams, likely MQL -> ARR if eval goes well. They asked for a short SOW (attached).

Proposed mitigations:
- Grant credit as one-off, non-recurring; require usage reporting and a short mutual action plan (MAP).
- If approved, add a clause: additional tokens expire at sandbox end and cannot be refunded or used as committed credit.
- Request signed addendum via DocuSign.

Can we get a quick yes/no from deal desk or an exec to approve one-off credit + 6-week extension?

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[aisha.rahman@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: Addendum_Request_Form.docx]
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — sandbox extension and additional credits

Appreciate the context, Aisha. A few notes from deal desk perspective:

1) Credit size — 250k tokens is material but not unreasonable for a multi-team eval.
2) Risk controls — we should require a one-page MAP with named milestones + an internal contact.
3) Accounting — mark credit as marketing/demo credit (not recognized revenue). Need finance ok for write-off.

I'll need executive sign-off for anything above 150k tokens for PLG-origin accounts. Markus — can you weigh in on approving a one-time variance (150k -> 250k) and the 6-week window? If yes, we'll prepare a DocuSign addendum and attach the MAP.

Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 14:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — sandbox extension and additional credits

Thanks for the write-up. I approve a one-time variance to grant the full 250k trial tokens and extend the sandbox expiry to 2028-09-30 under the following conditions:

- This is strictly a one-off, non-recurring sandbox credit.
- OrbitAI must sign the DocuSign addendum acknowledging the credit is promotional and non-refundable.
- A MAP (1 page) with three milestones is required and must be submitted within 3 business days of addendum signature.
- Finance will tag the credit as marketing expense — Alex, please coordinate with finance for write-off.

Aisha — you can communicate approval to OrbitAI and send the DocuSign link once the MAP is ready. I'll drop a note to legal if they need to review the addendum.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
